{"consolidated_memory":"CORRUPTED SCAFFOLD IN CLI/COMMANDS/INIT.PY — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Both incidents involve corrupted scaffold generation when initializing into a directory that already has a lockfile, manifesting as a generated tree missing one file.

INCIDENT 1 [2026-04-09]:
- File: cli/commands/init.py
- Affected: clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #3143, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1
- Outcome: reclaimed 62 GB of blob storage

INCIDENT 2 [2026-08-27]:
- File: cli/commands/init.py
- Trigger: appeared after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound (different root cause from Incident 1)
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #7775, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-2
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/cli/test_init.py
- Outcome: stopped 76 duplicate rows per day from being written

These are two distinct problems with the same symptom, both in the same file, both fixing different underlying causes."}
